headline: The NASDAQ Composite and S&P 500 extend their recovery as technology and semiconductor momentum carries forward alongside stabilizing macro indicators. Wall Street built on Wednesday's relief rally during Thursday's session, with institutional portfolios continuing to rotate back into artificial intelligence hardware, neocloud infrastructure, and mega-cap software following Anthropic's oversubscribed IPO demand and CoreWeave's upbeat revenue guidance. Sovereign fixed-income markets reopened from the Veterans Day holiday with steady demand, keeping the benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield anchored near 4.96% as bond desks digested cooler producer price inflation metrics. Meanwhile, international energy markets absorbed ongoing Middle East maritime friction, holding Brent crude oil futures steady around $92.80 a barrel as traders balanced Strait of Hormuz tanker strikes against rising U.S. crude inventories.
